conclusion: Registered rule: the early ladder's per-rung marginal progress is WITHIN the noise band of the late ladder's at matched compute. The more sensitive paired test agrees in sign and is small (t -3.02, 7/8 seeds negative). Therefore WHEN the ladder moves does not matter on this substrate, and the remaining lever is WHAT the rungs contain.
honest_bounds: the late arm reaches far fewer rungs (1-4) than the early arm (7-9); the paired test is truncated to min(rung counts) per seed, so it compares the SHARED prefix

residuals are computed against a two-parameter fit (intercept, slope) estimated from the committed timing line (n=17); the de-circularized quantity is therefore a RESIDUAL, not an independent measurement
residual magnitude (|delta| ~ 0.011-0.025) is ~0.2-0.5%% of the total held-out drop (~5.4); this is a null result with a small negative lean, not a large effect
metric_status: the RAW per-rung progress is CIRCULAR between arms (progress = -0.004022 + 0.8992 x remaining-drop, Pearson r = 0.9999, n = 17; found and recorded BEFORE the arms ran). All analysis below uses the DE-CIRCULARIZED residuals the source receipt stores in residuals_per_arm_seed.
next_falsification_unchanged: since timing is inert, test the OTHER lever: at matched compute, does the GOVERNED rung CONTENT produce more per-rung marginal progress than the legacy content? Requires a content A/B on the same ladder with the trigger held fixed.
not_licensed: that curriculum escalation is useless in general -- only that its TIMING is inert here

paired_matched_rung_index_test_post_hoc.why: the design IS paired (both arms ran the SAME 8 seeds) and the late arm has as few as 1 rung vs up to 9 for the early arm, so a pooled mean over unequal rung sequences is confounded; pairing at matched rung index removes the seed effect as common mode

pre_registered_test.statistic: mean(early residual) - mean(late residual), pooled within-arm sd as noise

question: does the EARLY ladder produce MORE per-rung marginal progress than the LATE ladder, beyond the measured cross-arm noise band, at matched compute?
